title: The pinned Agent set only ca, so NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0 turned verification off and a foreign server serving the public CA could get the token
resolution: The pinned Agent sets rejectUnauthorized true; tests under the variable refuse a foreign control plane and a foreign broker, whose client already pins it.

title: fetch followed redirects, so a 307 or 308 to http: carried the token without TLS and the client accepted the plain answer
resolution: Every request carries redirect error through the HttpFetch port, the CA read included; tests for 307 and 308 show the plain target gets nothing.

title: The guide's bootstrap step still copied the CA into the removed worker trust volume
resolution: The step names only the broker files; the worker gets the fingerprint through the enrollment bundle.

title: No test covered the control plane refusing an installation CA with a key, a second certificate, or a leaf
resolution: A unit test for readInstallationCa and an integration test of the start write each case and expect precondition-failed with the path and no PEM text.

title: The verification record still said that review had not run
resolution: The status names passes 1 and 2 and the pending pass 3.

title: The fail-before section said every test ran against the base, though some were mutations or ran on later revisions
resolution: Each item now names the revision it ran against or what was mutated.

title: The design and spec claimed tests showed that NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS does not widen the pin, but no test set it
resolution: A child-process test sets NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS to the foreign CA; an unpinned fetch trusts it, the pinned enrollment refuses it.

title: A refused pinned certificate was reported as unavailable, which the contract treats as a possibly spent token
resolution: An enrollment refused at the handshake fails with precondition-failed and reason installation-ca-untrusted; the contract says the token is not spent.

title: readInstallationCa could answer 400 and 401, which its OpenAPI operation does not declare
resolution: Its statuses are 503 and 500 only; a test checks every documented route's statuses against the execution document.

title: The server-only TLS sentence of Outbound connections only had no scenario
resolution: Scenario Server-only TLS, covered by the broker endpoint checks of enrollment-tls.test.ts.

title: The register said the worker adapter has one runtime dependency, though its workspace packages are runtime dependencies too
resolution: It says one third-party runtime dependency, undici.

title: The 2026-10-28 delegate decisions were only in the verification record
resolution: The design's context and the contract's decisions table name them and their run.

title: readInstallationCa named four different things, among them a private broker helper and the worker's pin reader
resolution: The broker helper is brokerTlsOf, and the journal's pin functions are readInstallationCaPin and writeInstallationCaPin.

title: The certificate refusal check read the described causeCode, which drops codes over 31 characters, so UNABLE_TO_GET_ISSUER_CERT_LOCALLY stayed unavailable
resolution: The refusal is read from the raw cause chain against the fixed code list and kept as details.certificateRefusal; a test through the client's error handling covers the long code.

title: The administrative entry reads the broker TLS before it checks the operator credential, so a missing CA can answer precondition-failed where forbidden is due
resolution: Deferred to a coordinator follow-up task: the same line is at the base 1c73e1a7, so it predates this change and lies outside the merge.
